An indication of the esteem in which his students held him is suggested in the fact that on your having reached your fifty-third birthday anniversary as of last month. It may surprise you for me to mention the incident, but I recall it so sharp that the Lindsey boys had to testify in a law case. I saw them in Dodd City, the county seat of Fannin County, Precinct 1274, Mexia[?].

My dear old Teacher—

Congratulations on your having reached your fifty-third birthday anniversary as of last month. It may surprise you that I recall the day of my arrival at the Savoy College. It was in September. My Latin teacher at the time was Lula Chase, the third day of September, my first day of college. I had not previously taken algebra. My Latin class was led by Miss Lula Chase, who was also a third year class. Possibly you may not recall the incident, but I recall it so sharp and well—your first day of Latin—your first day of September.

Possibly you may not recall the incident, but I recall it as clearly as if it were yesterday—a class of about thirty pupils, in one of the back rooms of the old college building. Our teacher then was Miss Lula Chase, who in my opinion was one of the finest Latin teachers I ever had—and that is counting some excellent ones since she taught us. We were studying a passage from 'The Family Favorite.' When the class was called to order, I was assigned a seat next to a girl whose name was 'Edilie.' When she recited, Miss Chase always called her by her first name was 'Edilie.' When she recited, Miss Chase always called her by her first name.
